node.title: L1 FPC5: rate-half M=4,t=3 guarded split-slice payment
node.statement: At the official rate-half row, aggregate every first-owned M=4,t=3 FPC5 contributor in the Johnson-nonpositive tail over carried sources, touched triples, defects, and normalized source cross-ratios. For N=4ell+b-2, d=2ell-a, b>=7, 1<=a<=floor((b-3)/4), and J<=0, each fixed cell is exactly the guarded LS6 atom of monic divisors D|L_C with deg D=2ell-a, deg rem_(L_2L_3)(D Etilde)<=ell-a, and gcd(D,rem(D Etilde))=1. The required conclusion is one disjoint polynomial/profile allocation of the total, not a per-cell dimension estimate.
node.attack_surface: prove a max-to-mean split-divisor bound, a collective first-owner injection, or a quotient/field-drop classification for the exact LS6 slices
node.falsifier: a rate-half source family whose first-owned guarded LS6 mass exceeds every polynomial and every legitimate quotient/profile column
